note: Strong connectivity is naturally much lower for a directed one-way street network (many dead-end/cul-de-sac one-way segments cannot round-trip) -- weak connectivity is the more relevant reachability measure for cutoff-Dijkstra accessibility queries, reported alongside strong connectivity for full transparency, not in place of it.
